materials_exhausted.note: Owner-layer rework consumed local XML/NXML tables and sections, PDF text, OA package members, supplementary PDF text, locator index, and linked DBAASP/CAMP JSONL rows. No external acquisition was needed and no owner-layer source gap remains.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 rechecked linked DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows against article metadata, peptide sequence/modification text, antimicrobial methods, and Table 2 activity rows. U-MYRTX-MANr1 rows are source_verified; Myrmica comparator and CAMP aggregate rows retain explicit caution statuses instead of being smoothed away.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 replaced the empty parser output with source-backed row-level records from antimicrobial text/methods, XML Table 2/3, and supplementary PDF text Tables S1/S6. Rows retain endpoints, raw values, units or qualitative-unit rationale, target species/strain, conditions, statistics when reported, and source locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 accepts only phenotype-level insecticidal and wound-healing/coagulation context. The final mechanism record does not claim a direct molecular target, antimicrobial mechanism, or exact channel/coagulation-protein target.
per_layer_decision_rationale.adjudication: The blocking rework ticket rwk-complete-test-0001 is closed after owner-layer source review. Acceptance remains accepted_with_cautions because comparator/database-only rows and bounded mechanism interpretation require visible cautions.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed owner-layer rework repaired the missing activity/toxicity rows, adjudicated linked database conflicts, and replaced framework-test review placeholders. The paper is publication-grade accepted_with_cautions with no open rework targets and no unrecoverable owner-layer gaps.
summary: U-MYRTX-MANr1 is source-supported as an amidated Manica rubida decapeptide with no antimicrobial activity up to 512 ug/mL but strong injection insecticidal phenotype in Acyrthosiphon pisum; database conflicts are preserved where local primary support is incomplete.

caution_findings.finding: MIC rows are reported as no activity up to 512 ug/mL, not exact MIC values; final rows use >512 ug/mL and avoid converting to molar units.

U-MYRTX-MYRrub1 comparator activity values are source-supported in this paper, but sequence/identity primary support is cited prior work; database rows remain source_conflict rather than source_verified.
Two CAMP aggregate rows are retained as database_only_no_primary_source because no local CAMP sequence snapshot or identifier mapping exists.
Aphid toxicity, paralysis, and hemolymph/wound-healing effects are source-backed phenotypes; final curation does not claim a direct molecular target.
The local supplement is a PDF; recoverable tables were extracted from local text, and no separate spreadsheet asset was present.
